Subject: Re: L-44131 - Update on Your Order
 

 Dear Nancy,
 

 I apologize for the delay in responding to your inquiries about your order. We dispatched your items on December 15th. Unfortunately, they have not been delivered to you, but I want to reassure you that we are actively re-expediting your package.
 

 You will soon receive an email with the tracking number so you can monitor your package's progress as it makes its way to you.
 

 Thank you for your patience and understanding.
 

 Warm regards,
 

 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay

Hello Nancy,
 

 We apologize for the much longer response time than usual. We are currently receiving a higher number of requests than usual, but we are doing everything possible to process them quickly.
 

 Both packages are identical. We enclosed to this mail a return label so you can send one of the packages back to us.
 

 Thank you for your honesty, and we are happy to count you among our customers. Have a great day! 😊
 

 Warm regards,
